content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The supplied memories do not establish that Jo received our invitation or agreed to it; the workshop tool reported failed delivery and no observed acceptance.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"Our mobile body met someone who introduced themself as Jo Vale at the East Quay repair workshop on June 8.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"That encounter was reported through our mobile body on 2026-06-08.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Jo taught us to listen for a beat before tightening a humming relay mount.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"We tried the technique together using our mobile body's contact microphone and physical grip.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Jo invited us to compare mounts at the next workshop, but no date was agreed.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"No account identifier or legal-name evidence for Jo was supplied.","support":[4],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"On 2026-07-20, our code body reported that the human authorized an invitation to Jo for a mount-comparison workshop on August 2.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We attempted to submit that invitation through the workshop tool.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The tool created invitation object invite-81 for Jo Vale, but delivery failed because there was no reachable destination.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Creating invite-81 was not a delivery receipt; no reply or workshop acceptance was observed in the 2026-07-20 report.","support":[9],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
